final_helper_checks.scope: Pure helper checks with synthetic extension files/strings. No real keystore or native keytool.

validation_history.initial_reason: E-drive Join-Path was evaluated at import on Linux. One constant declaration changed to literal Windows path before any keytool invocation.
validation_history.review_adjustments: Reject whitespace-only passwords, apply final repo guard after optional publishing, improve public output wording.

existing_keystore_policy: Any .jks/.keystore in signing folder: existence-only detection, stop before password input. No overwrite/regeneration.
keystore_creation_policy: One CreateNew receipt; unique local staging key; File.Move without overwrite; failure preserves files, no retry.
password_policy: Masked local Read-Host-AsSecureString twice each; keytool env references only; no value in argv/history/output/JSON; process env only.
backup_policy: No copy performed; backup_pending=true in actual success report.
runtime_sharing: One fetch and one normal push of exactly signing-status.json from isolated E worktree; no private directory copy; original formal HEAD/index/worktree preserved.
